#### Softmax straight from its formula

A trained network can be confident, with [logits](#def-logits) in the hundreds.
Multiply the first test image's logits from @exm-logits by 1,000,
and compute the softmax with its formula, `torch.exp(z) / torch.exp(z).sum()`.
What goes wrong?
